dcterms:description: CARLA is an open-source simulator for autonomous driving research, providing a flexible environment for training, prototyping, and validating autonomous driving models. It includes urban layouts, vehicles, and environmental conditions for simulation.
dcterms:title: CARLA

dcterms:description: A dataset of driving traces recorded by human drivers in the training town, consisting of tuples of observations, commands, and actions.
dcterms:title: Driving Traces Dataset
